sources.title: fetiai-v1-phiusiil-binclf-knn-skl-500k - GitHub
sources.snippet: It holds a bare scikit-learn estimator rather than a wrapper class, so unpickling depends on scikit-learn alone and on nothing defined in this repository. If you want a model that loads without executing anything, the from-scratch counterpart in fetiai-v1-phiusiil-binclf-knn-scratch-500k is plain a NumPy .npz of the reference matrix and its labels.
